body.message:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We completely understand your concerns and appreciate you taking the time to share your observations with us.

Please note that the apartment will remain in the same condition and with the same amenities as you viewed during the inspection. However, prior to your arrival, the unit will be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized to ensure it is prepared for your stay.

We always encourage guests to view the apartment before confirming the booking so they can ensure that the unit meets their expectations. Regarding the rental rate, it is fixed and, unfortunately, we are unable to offer a reduction.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and hope you will still consider proceeding with the apartment.
